{{Quote|We're suiting up for wetwork!|Gyran|<ref name="Barani">{{WEGCite|book=Secrets of the Sisar Run|story=The Barani Conspiracy}}</ref>}}
'''Wetsuits''' were articles of [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] worn for [[Ocean/Legends|aquatic]] purposes. They were available for purchase throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in large [[City/Legends|cities]] and [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]]. Wetsuits retailed for four hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="SWS" />

Bodyhugging affairs, they offered the wearer complete protection from [[Water/Legends|water]]&mdash;with a wetsuit and a [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]], [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]]-breathers could function underwater. [[Ket Maliss]], [[Gyran]], and other members of a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] team assembled by [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun's]] [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] wore wetsuits while searching for the stolen [[Barani List]] in an underwater [[Sedrian village|village]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]].
